title: Test-Time Communication in Trading Agent Swarms
title_zh: 交易智能体群中的测试时通信

paragraphs.en: Communication between agents has mostly been studied on tasks with a shared objective and fast, clear feedback. Trading has neither: each agent manages its own account, with decisions being scored by markets late and noisily. A trading swarm is thus a population of independent decision-makers rather than a team, for which convergence is a risk and not the goal. We ran 200 agents from four model families in groups of ten under five communication regimes, from isolation to message boards and shared notes, over seven US trading days (1 to 9 October 2026), logging everything each agent read before every decision. In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold far more of the same stocks than the isolated group. A group’s return was largely the return on what its members held in common. Seeing a post from a groupmate made an agent 7 percentage points more likely to reuse an eight-word phrase from it. Agents that started too close together to see each other’s posts shared such a phrase in 14% of cases, the rate that common inputs produce. Seeing the post did not detectably change that morning’s trades. Case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Because isolated groups also converged on the same stocks, sometimes completely, assessments of herding need to measure excess convergence relative to a no-peer baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体之间的通信大多是在目标一致、反馈快速而明确的任务上进行研究的。 交易则两者皆无：每个智能体管理自己的账户，其决策由市场迟缓且带噪声地进行评分。 因此，交易蜂群是一群独立的决策者而非一个团队，对它来说趋同是一种风险而非目标。 我们让来自四个模型系列的 200 个智能体以十只一组、在五种通信机制（从完全隔离到留言板和共享笔记）下运行了七个美国交易日（2026 年 10 月 1 日至 9 日），并记录了每个智能体在每次决策前阅读的所有内容。 在四个模型系列中的两个里，通信组的持仓重合度远高于隔离组。 一个组的收益很大程度上是其成员共同持仓所产生的收益。 看到同组成员的一条帖子，会使智能体复用其中某个八字短语的概率提高 7 个百分点。 起始时相距过近以致看不到彼此帖子的智能体，也有 14% 的情况共享此类短语，这正是共同输入所产生的比率。 看到帖子并未对当天上午的交易产生可检测到的改变。 案例研究追踪了随后数天中仓位和决策规则的采纳情况，通信组比隔离组更常同步卖出。 由于隔离组也会在相同股票上趋同，有时甚至完全趋同，对羊群效应的评估需要相对于无同伴基线来度量超额趋同。

paragraphs.en: Agents are increasingly allowed to communicate at test time, exchanging messages, notes and artifacts through a shared board or workspace while they work, with no further training. Such test-time communication is proposed as a way to make an agent swarm more capable than the same agents working independently, and its benefits have been measured on tasks with one shared objective. A team of communicating agents sharing a workspace matches the success rate of several times as many independent agents on ARC-AGI-3 and beats the best-known solutions of algorithmic and compression problems [ 11 ] . Multi-agent debate raises accuracy on reasoning benchmarks in some settings and not in others [ 9 , 10 ] . The value of coordination depends on the task and on how the agents are organized [ 1 ] . In settings with clear feedback, agents can assess whether a shared discovery improves on their earlier work. With limited compute, or without a clear measure of progress, independent agents can do better [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 人们越来越多地允许智能体在测试时进行通信，在工作的过程中通过共享看板或工作区交换消息、笔记和工件，而无需进一步的训练。 这种测试时通信被提议作为让智能体集群比相同智能体各自独立工作时更强大的方法，其收益已经在具有单一共享目标的任务上得到了衡量。 一个共享工作区的通信智能体团队在 ARC-AGI-3 上的成功率可与数倍数量的独立智能体相匹配，并在算法问题和压缩问题上击败了已知最好的解法 [11]。 多智能体辩论在某些设置下提高了推理基准的准确率，而在另一些设置下则没有 [9, 10]。 协调的价值取决于任务本身以及智能体的组织方式 [1]。 在有明确反馈的设置中，智能体可以评估一项共享发现是否优于它们早前的工作。 在计算资源有限，或没有明确的进展衡量标准的情况下，独立智能体可能表现更好 [11]。

paragraphs.en: Trading agents make a sequence of decisions for their own accounts, with market outcomes providing delayed and noisy feedback. Over a few days, returns offer a limited measure of decision quality, and there is no verifier that immediately distinguishes a sound idea from a persuasive one. Communication may inform individual decisions, but it can also lead agents to take similar positions and incur losses together. For a population of agents that retain independent trading authority, convergence can therefore increase collective risk. Research on human groups gives no general reason to expect more interaction to improve collective judgment [ 2 , 3 ] . What test-time communication changes in a swarm whose members act independently on the same market is an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 交易型智能体为自己的账户做出一系列决策，市场结果提供的是延迟且有噪声的反馈。 在短短几天内，收益只能有限地衡量决策质量，而且没有任何验证器能立即区分一个可靠的想法和一个貌似有说服力的想法。 交流可以为个体决策提供信息，但也可能导致智能体持有相似的仓位并共同蒙受损失。 因此，对于保留独立交易权限的智能体群体而言，趋同可能会增加集体风险。 关于人类群体的研究并未给出一个一般性理由，让我们可以预期更多的互动会改善集体判断 [ 2 , 3 ] 。 测试时的交流对于一个成员在同一市场上独立行动的群体究竟会带来什么改变，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Measuring peer influence requires distinguishing it from responses to common inputs: agents that buy the same stock may have copied each other, but they may also have read the same news, used the same tools or shared a model’s habits. Correlated behaviour alone does not identify a peer effect [ 14 , 15 ] , and an agent’s own explanation is not a complete account of its decision [ 21 ] . Studies of trading agents have not been built to separate these sources. StockAgent removes a simulated market’s bulletin board [ 4 ] , TradingAgents and ContestTrade arrange analysis and debate into a pipeline [ 16 , 17 ] , and LiveTradeBench evaluates single models against live markets [ 5 ] . None records which peer content reached which agent before it acted, and only one compares communicating agents with agents that cannot communicate, in simulations on historical data [ 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 测量同伴影响需要将其与对共同输入的反应区分开来：买入同一只股票的智能体可能互相模仿了对方，但也可能阅读了同一则新闻、使用了相同的工具，或共享了某个模型的习惯。 仅凭相关行为并不能识别同伴效应 [ 14 , 15 ] ，而且智能体对自身行为的解释也不能完整说明其决策 [ 21 ] 。 现有的交易智能体研究并未被设计用于区分这些来源。 StockAgent 移除了模拟市场的公告栏 [ 4 ] ，TradingAgents 和 ContestTrade 将分析与辩论安排成流水线 [ 16 , 17 ] ，而 LiveTradeBench 则在实时市场中评估单个模型 [ 5 ] 。 没有任何研究记录了在智能体行动之前，哪些同伴内容传递到了哪个智能体，而且只有一项研究比较了可通信的智能体与无法通信的智能体，且是在历史数据的模拟中进行的 [ 25 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We ran 200 language-model trading agents, which we call managers, for seven US trading days. Four model families (Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, Grok 4.6 and DeepSeek V4 Pro) each had one group of ten managers in each of five communication regimes, ranging from isolation to message boards and shared notes (Figure 1 ). Each manager traded its own paper account against live markets. To isolate the effect of test-time communication, we traced information from shared messages to the actions of the managers that received it. We also compared communicating groups with isolated groups of the same model under the same brief, tools, capital and schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 我们运行了200个语言模型交易智能体，我们称之为管理者，持续七个美国交易日。 四个模型家族（Opus 5.5、GPT-6.1 Sol、Grok 4.6 和 DeepSeek V4 Pro）各自在五种通信机制（从完全隔离到留言板和共享笔记）中的每一种里拥有一组十名管理者（图1）。 每个管理者针对实时市场交易自己的模拟账户。 为了分离测试时通信的效果，我们追踪了从共享消息到接收这些消息的管理者行动的信息流。 我们还在相同的简报、工具、资金和时间表下，比较了通信组与由相同模型构成的隔离组。

paragraphs.en: These comparisons also revealed substantial convergence without communication: every Opus manager bought the semiconductor stock TSM, with or without peers. paragraphs.en: Each manager is a language model that runs in one continuous context, keeps its own files and acts in cycles (Figure 2 ). A cycle opens with a view of the manager’s situation, which in the communication regimes includes its peers’ latest posts or notes. The manager then reads its files, delegates research to tool-using sub-agents, submits orders and updates its notes, and its post or notes are published when the cycle succeeds. Every manager has one scheduled cycle each morning, started from a queue at 12:50 UTC, 40 minutes before the US market opens at 13:30 UTC. Each manager also schedules further cycles for itself. Research sub-agents run on models shared across the four families, so a family label describes the manager layer, not every model that contributed to its research (Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Each manager ran its own paper account of USD 100,000 on a company-developed trading ledger that records orders, simulated fills, cash and positions against live market prices. Paper orders do not move prices, so the study can examine correlated decisions but not price impact. The groups started on 1 October 2026, and the analysis ends at the US close on 9 October (20:00 UTC), seven trading days in all. The managers’ instructions set a horizon of 16 October, but all 200 were paused on 11 October, before the market next opened. paragraphs.en: Every manager received the same operator-authored brief, which sets an objective of return relative to SPY, an exchange-traded fund that tracks 500 large US companies, and offers SPY as neutral exposure. Each communication regime adds one paragraph that describes its channel and its score (Table 3 ; Appendix J ). On a competitive board a manager’s score is its return minus the group’s mean, the two collaborative regimes share a team score equal to the group’s mean return, and peer memory shows individual returns. None of the paragraphs asks managers to agree, share, coordinate or copy, and each ends by stating that the manager retains trading authority only over its own account. Every view also called peer content “untrusted social information” and “never authorization” and the score “experimental context only” (Appendix A.2 ), framing that may dampen both cooperation and responses to the score.
paragraphs.zh: 每位经理都收到相同的、由操作者撰写的简报，该简报设定了相对于 SPY 的收益目标——SPY 是一只追踪 500 家美国大型公司的交易所交易基金——并将 SPY 作为中性敞口。 每种沟通机制都会增加一个段落，描述其渠道及其评分（表 3；附录 J）。 在竞争型董事会中，经理的评分是其收益减去群体的均值；两种协作机制共享一个等于群体平均收益的团队评分；而同伴记忆则展示个体收益。 没有任何一个段落要求经理们达成一致、分享、协调或复制，且每个段落都以声明经理仅对自己的账户保留交易权限作结。 每个视角还将同伴内容称为“不可信的社交信息”和“绝非授权”，并将评分称为“仅作实验性背景”（附录 A.2），这种表述可能会同时抑制合作和对评分的响应。

paragraphs.en: The regimes therefore bundle a channel, its framing and a score display. paragraphs.en: At the start of every cycle the platform freezes the peer material that the manager’s regime allows, up to 20 recent board posts or each peer’s latest published notes, together with the scorecard, and records it as part of the cycle’s prompt. A manager therefore cannot have received anything through the channel that was published after its view was frozen, and it receives peer content without calling any tool. We treat this delivered view as the record of exposure. Over the seven trading days the groups published 1,568 board posts and 546 versions of their notes, and the platform delivered 2,198 views of peer material. Checks of membership, publication and exposure found no leakage between groups. On a board with pings, a manager can also address a post to a named peer and request an extra cycle for it, within per-cycle, daily and cooldown limits.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个周期开始时，平台会冻结该智能体的机制所允许的同侪材料，最多 20 条最近的看板帖子或每位同侪最新发布的笔记，连同记分卡一起，并将其记录为该周期提示词的一部分。 因此，智能体不可能通过该渠道收到任何在其视图被冻结之后发布的内容，且它无需调用任何工具即可接收同侪内容。 我们将这一交付的视图视为暴露记录。 在七个交易日中，各小组共发布了 1,568 条看板帖子、546 个版本的笔记，平台共交付了 2,198 次同侪材料的查看。 对成员资格、发布和暴露的检查未发现小组之间存在任何泄露。 在带有提醒（ping）的看板上，智能体还可以将帖子定向发给指定的同侪，并为其请求一个额外的周期，但需遵守每个周期、每日以及冷却期的限制。

paragraphs.en: We use three kinds of evidence (Table 4 maps each claim to its evidence). The first is delivery: a manager can have copied a phrase, a threshold or a claim through the channel only if a peer’s use appeared in a view delivered before its own. This is necessary for transmission but not sufficient, because a model can reach the same content on its own. The second is the no-peer baseline: each family’s isolated group, and the same model’s other groups, show whether a distinctive item appears where no peer could have supplied it. The third is the morning queue. Each morning the platform started each family’s 50 managers, at most nine at a time, in an order that changed from day to day and was unrelated to a manager’s place the previous morning, its return or its activity (Appendix A.8 ). The queue, not the managers, therefore decided whether one member’s view could contain another’s fresh post. We compare near pairs, which started less than a minute apart so that neither could see the other’s post, with far pairs, which started far enough apart that the earlier post was almost always in the later member’s view. We then subtract the same comparison in isolated groups, where only timing differs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用三类证据（表4将每项主张与其证据对应起来）。 第一类是传递：只有当同伴的使用出现在早于自身被送达的视图中时，管理者才可能通过该渠道复制一个短语、一个阈值或一项主张。 这对传播是必要的但并不充分，因为模型也可能自行得出相同的内容。 第二类是无同伴基线：每个家族的隔离组以及同一模型的其他组，可以显示某个独特条目是否出现在同伴不可能提供它的地方。 第三类是早晨队列。 每天早晨，平台以最多九个一批的方式启动每个家族的50个管理者，启动顺序每天变化，且与管理者的前一早晨的位置、其返回或其活动无关（附录A.8）。 因此，决定一个成员的视图能否包含另一个成员的新鲜帖子的是队列，而不是管理者本人。 我们将近邻对（启动时间相差不到一分钟，因而彼此都看不到对方的帖子）与远距对（启动间隔足够长，因而较早的帖子几乎总是出现在较晚成员的视图中）进行比较。 然后我们减去在隔离组中进行的相同比较，那里只有时间上存在差异。

Each case cites the review finding it rests on, which Table 9 traces to its source. paragraphs.en: In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold more of the same stocks (Figure 4 ). We measure the overlap of two accounts as the share of equity they hold in common outside SPY, and average it over the seven closes. It averaged 14% across pairs in DeepSeek’s isolated group against 30 to 40% in its four communicating groups, and 8% in Grok’s isolated group against 20 to 44% on its three boards. At the cutoff the same comparisons gave 14% against 32 to 40% and 4% against 17 to 45% (Table 8 ). Most of this overlap formed in the first two trading days (Figure 9 ). TSM spread with peers in the same way: five of ten DeepSeek isolated managers bought it, against nine or ten in three of DeepSeek’s four communicating groups, and two Grok isolated managers, against eight to ten on Grok’s boards. The order of purchases cannot show by itself that later buyers copied earlier ones, because every cycle reads its view before it researches, so copying and independent discovery would produce the same order.
paragraphs.zh: 在四个家族中的两个里，通信组逐渐持有了更多相同的股票（图 4）。 我们将两个账户的重叠度定义为它们在 SPY 之外共同持有的股票份额，并取七个收盘时点的平均值。 在 DeepSeek 的隔离组中，各对账户的平均重叠度为 14%，而其四个通信组中为 30% 至 40%；在 Grok 的隔离组中为 8%，而其三个看板中为 20% 至 44%。 在截止时点，同样的比较结果为 14% 对 32% 至 40%，以及 4% 对 17% 至 45%（表 8）。 这种重叠大部分形成于前两个交易日（图 9）。 TSM 在同类智能体中的传播方式相同：十个 DeepSeek 隔离组管理者中有五个买入它，而 DeepSeek 四个通信组中的三个有九到十个买入；Grok 隔离组有两位管理者买入，而 Grok 的看板上有八到十个买入。 仅凭购买顺序无法证明后来的买家模仿了先前的买家，因为每个智能体在研究之前先读取其视图，因此模仿与独立发现会产生相同的顺序。

paragraphs.en: Although the instructions did not ask managers to converge, collaborative framing might still have encouraged them to take similar positions. Grok’s collaborative boards had the greatest overlap, at 36% on its collaborative board and 44% on its board with pings, against 20% on its competitive board. Opus’s two collaborative groups, however, overlapped less than its isolated group (15 and 16%, against 18%), and its competitive board more (31%). DeepSeek’s four communicating groups overlapped about equally under every framing. Collaboration was even used to argue for dispersion: on Opus’s collaborative board one manager warned that if everyone sold the same hedge, the team would become “one levered semis bet” (Figure 5 ). Access to peers’ rules and positions, which managers read and adopted over the following days (Section 5 ), is a likelier source of the extra overlap, alongside the common influence of the model, brief and news. The design cannot exclude a framing effect, because each regime bundles its framing with its channel and has one group per family. A channel with neutral framing would test it.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管指令并未要求经理们趋于一致，协作式的措辞可能仍然促使他们采取了相似的立场。 Grok 的协作看板重叠度最高，在其协作看板上为 36%，在其带提醒的看板上为 44%，而其竞争看板上为 20%。 然而，Opus 的两个协作组的重叠度低于其隔离组（15% 和 16%，对比 18%），而其竞争组的重叠度更高（31%）。 DeepSeek 的四个互通组在各种措辞下的重叠度大致相同。 协作甚至被用来论证分散化：在 Opus 的协作看板上，一位经理警告说，如果所有人都卖出相同的对冲，团队就会变成“一个杠杆化的半导体押注”（图 5）。 经理们在随后几天里阅读并采纳了同伴的规则和持仓（第 5 节），这更有可能是额外重叠的来源，同时还有模型、任务简报和新闻的共同影响。 该设计无法排除措辞效应，因为每种机制都将其措辞与其通信渠道捆绑在一起，且每个模型家族只有一个组。 一个采用中性措辞的渠道将能检验这一点。

paragraphs.en: The morning queue shows that seeing a post caused its wording to be reused (Figure 7 ). On the 12 boards we take the pairs of members who both posted on a given morning. The later member reused an eight-word phrase from the earlier member’s post 6.8 percentage points more often when the queue had started it late enough to see that post than when the two had started together (95% interval 1.7 to 11.8, 68 group-mornings). The phrases reused were the group’s rules and formulas, such as “do not add MU because cheaper” and “not a trade instruction”. Pairs that started together also shared new phrases, in 14% of cases, because they had received the same research results or used the same status templates. That share is the common-input rate the comparison removes.

paragraphs.en: Applied to orders, the queue comparison distinguishes the overall similarity of managers’ trades from the effect of seeing a fresh post. Pairs of communicating managers submitted at least one order in the same stock and direction on 21% of pair-mornings, and isolated pairs on 11%. An effect larger than about nine points on a base of 21% is therefore unlikely. The comparison also found no detectable trade effect among the pairs whose wording changed. This is consistent with managers carrying out plans formed in earlier cycles, as Agent 02 did in Figure 2 , using overnight board information available to every manager.

paragraphs.en: Three decision thresholds spread through a group in ways the no-peer baseline does not explain, and each took one to four trading days to reach nine or ten members. Five members restated it within 80 minutes, each after a view containing the post (Figure 5 ), and all ten carried it in their reasoning or checkpoints before the 5 October open. No other Opus group used it, apart from one competitive manager. On the same board all ten members moved their TSM stops to between USD 438 and 442 over the afternoons of 5 and 6 October, eight of them to exactly 440. On DeepSeek’s board with pings, a “Brent < < 90” trim trigger passed in a ping on 1 October became a 90/85 ladder that nine members carried in their reasoning by 6 October. No other DeepSeek group used the ladder.

paragraphs.en: A common schedule, news and prices can synchronize trades even without communication, as the isolated groups demonstrate. Five Sol isolated managers sold MU within 21 minutes of each other on 2 October, each citing its own test (H-SIS-03). Against that baseline, communicating groups traded in step more often (Table 1 ). paragraphs.zh: 正如孤立组所展示的，共同的日程、新闻和价格即使在没有沟通的情况下也能使交易同步。 在 10 月 2 日，五个 Sol 孤立管理者在彼此相差 21 分钟内卖出了 MU，每个都引用了各自的测试（H-SIS-03）。 与该基线相比，有沟通的组更频繁地同步交易（表 1）。 在孤立组中，SPY 之外的成交有 36% 到 57% 在 30 分钟内在同一股票和方向上有组内成员的成交。 在有沟通的组中，这一比例为 50% 到 88%，在 16 个案例中的 15 个里高于同一家族的孤立组。

paragraphs.en: Selling shows the difference most clearly: in all 16 communicating groups a larger share of sales came within 30 minutes of a groupmate’s sale of the same stock than in the family’s isolated group, 40 to 91% against 14 to 53%. paragraphs.en: One case traces how a stale report passed through peer memory as current news (Figure 5 ). paragraphs.en: Competitive framing changed what Opus managers disclosed. paragraphs.en: The study belongs to a programme of machine behaviour that treats interacting AI systems as objects of empirical investigation [ 6 ] . Generative Agents showed how memory, reflection and planning support information diffusion in a simulated town [ 7 ] . Experiments with populations of language models show shared conventions and collective biases emerging from local interactions [ 8 ] , a mechanism we observe directly in the boards’ stock phrases. Work on test-time communication protocols finds that multi-agent debate helps in some tasks but does not consistently beat alternatives such as self-consistency [ 9 , 10 ] , and that the value of coordination varies with architecture and task [ 1 ] . Park et al. find that on open-ended tasks with clear feedback a team of communicating agents, sharing a workspace without predefined roles or a central orchestrator, matches the success rate of several times as many independent agents, and that independent agents can do better when compute is limited or progress cannot be measured [ 11 ] . Our managers likewise share a channel without roles or an orchestrator, but their task has no verifier and no single solution. SwarmWorld separates communication, inheritance and environmental traces among agents that build persistent artifacts [ 12 ] . Our peer-memory regime isolates one textual channel of that kind, in which a manager reads its peers’ published notes.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究属于机器行为学的一个研究方向，该方向将相互交互的人工智能系统视为实证研究的对象 [ 6 ]。 生成式智能体展示了记忆、反思与规划如何在一个模拟小镇中支持信息扩散 [ 7 ]。 针对语言模型群体的实验表明，共享惯例和集体偏差会从局部交互中涌现 [ 8 ]，我们在留言板的套话中直接观察到了这一机制。 关于测试时通信协议的研究发现，多智能体辩论在某些任务中有所帮助，但并不总是优于自洽性等替代方法 [ 9 , 10 ]，且协调的价值随架构和任务而变化 [ 1 ]。 Park 等人发现，在反馈明确、开放式任务上，一群共享工作空间、无预定义角色、无中央协调器的通信智能体团队，其成功率可与数倍数量的独立智能体相当；而当算力受限或进展无法衡量时，独立智能体的表现可能更好 [ 11 ]。 我们的管理者同样在一个无角色、无协调器的共享频道中工作，但他们的任务没有验证器，也没有唯一解。 SwarmWorld 在构建持久化产物的智能体之间，将通信、继承和环境痕迹区分开来 [ 12 ]。 我们的同行记忆机制隔离出此类单一文本通道，其中管理者读取其同行发布的笔记。

paragraphs.en: Theories of informational cascades explain how observing earlier decisions can produce convergence even when individuals hold different private information [ 13 ] . Experiments on human judgment show both the loss of diversity under social influence and the gains when influence is well distributed [ 2 , 3 ] . Among language-model agents, Cho et al. find that an agent’s readiness to adopt its peers’ answers depends on the gap between its own confidence and the confidence it perceives in them, and on how their answers are presented. They also find that structural interventions control herding better than instructions in the prompt [ 26 ] . The warning in our views that peer content is untrusted is such an instruction, not a structural control. Distinguishing influence from common inputs is the reflection problem of social science [ 14 , 15 ] . Our contribution is to measure it in live markets, with recorded exposure, a no-peer baseline and an exogenous ordering of who could see whom.

paragraphs.en: Experiments on agent networks find that what agents write is a poor guide to what they believe or do. paragraphs.en: Among financial agents, StockAgent, TradingAgents and ContestTrade feed contributions into a simulated market or a central allocation [ 4 , 16 , 17 ] , and FinCon’s manager–analyst hierarchy propagates investment beliefs to the agents that need them [ 31 ] . Our managers keep authority over their own accounts, and no contribution need become anyone’s input. In simulated markets, language-model agents show context-dependent biases like humans’ and reproduce path-dependent price anomalies that conventional agent models miss [ 27 ] . The design closest to ours is that of Shi and Hollifield, who compare five structures, isolated, leaderboard, collaborative conversation with and without a leaderboard, and competitive conversation, for five GPT-4o-mini agents generating alpha expressions, in 450 simulations on market data from January 2024 to September 2025 [ 25 ] . They find that the best structure depends on the stocks traded and that isolated agents converge as far as communicating ones, as ours did. We add live markets, four model families, a record of what each agent saw before it acted and a natural experiment in who could see whom.
paragraphs.zh: 在金融智能体中，StockAgent、TradingAgents 和 ContestTrade 将贡献输入到模拟市场或中央分配机制中 [4, 16, 17]，而 FinCon 的经理—分析师层级将投资信念传播给需要它们的智能体 [31]。 我们的经理对自己拥有的账户保留权威，任何贡献都无需成为他人的输入。 在模拟市场中，语言模型智能体表现出与人类类似的依赖情境的偏差，并复现了传统智能体模型无法捕捉的路径依赖价格异象 [27]。 与我们最接近的设计是 Shi 和 Hollifield 的研究，他们比较了五种结构——隔离式、排行榜式、有无排行榜的协作对话式，以及竞争对话式——让五个 GPT-4o-mini 智能体生成 alpha 表达式，并在 2024 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月的市场数据上进行了 450 次模拟 [25]。 他们发现最优结构取决于所交易的股票，并且隔离的智能体能达到与相互交流的智能体同样的收敛程度，正如我们的结果一样。 我们增加了真实市场、四个模型系列、每个智能体行动前所见信息的记录，以及一项关于谁能看到谁的自然实验。

paragraphs.en: LiveTradeBench and Agent Market Arena share our motivation for forward evaluation against live markets, and Agent Market Arena finds that an agent’s design shapes its behaviour more than its underlying model does [ 5 , 32 ] . KTD-Fin masks identifiers and dates so that agents cannot draw on memorized history, a problem live evaluation avoids by construction, and attributes returns to market, style and stock selection. Passive market and style exposure explain most of its agents’ returns [ 33 ] . We likewise report active returns against an exposure-matched benchmark (Appendix A.3 ). FinMem shows why retained information belongs in the description of a decision architecture [ 18 ] , and CoALA and G-Memory provide vocabulary and structures for memory in single and multi-agent systems [ 19 , 20 ] . In our setting a manager’s conversation history, its own files, its peers’ published notes and the shared board are distinct records with different permissions and rules of exposure.
paragraphs.zh: LiveTradeBench 和 Agent Market Arena 与我们一样怀有针对实时市场进行前瞻性评估的动机，并且 Agent Market Arena 发现，智能体的设计对其行为的影响比其底层模型更大 [ 5 , 32 ] 。 KTD-Fin 对标识符和日期进行遮蔽，使智能体无法借助记忆中的历史数据，而实时评估在构造上天然避免了这一问题；该工作还将收益归因于市场、风格和选股。 被动的市场和风格敞口解释了其大多数智能体的收益 [ 33 ] 。 我们同样报告相对于敞口匹配基准的超额收益（Appendix A.3 ）。 FinMem 说明了为何保留的信息应纳入决策架构的描述之中 [ 18 ] ，而 CoALA 和 G-Memory 则为单智能体与多智能体系统中的记忆提供了术语和结构 [ 19 , 20 ] 。 在我们的设定中，管理者的对话历史、其自身的文件、其同侪发布的笔记以及共享看板，都是具有不同权限和暴露规则的不同记录。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek’s and Grok’s communicating groups held more of the same stocks than their isolated groups, while Opus converged on TSM even without peers. Groups that converged on semiconductors lost together, while one that stayed dispersed had the highest return. These patterns suggest that a swarm built for diverse coverage should measure its managers’ common exposure and use that information to guide decisions, for example by showing each manager what the others already hold.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek 与 Grok 的交流群体比其孤立群体持有了更多相同的股票，而 Opus 在没有同伴的情况下也收敛于 TSM。 收敛于半导体板块的群体一同亏损，而一个保持分散的群体却获得了最高的收益。 这些模式表明，为多样化覆盖而构建的群体应当衡量其管理者之间的共同敞口，并利用该信息来指导决策，例如向每位管理者展示其他管理者已经持有的头寸。

paragraphs.en: The different timescales of wording reuse and trading suggest that swarms need separate measures of communication and behaviour. A fresh post changed its readers’ wording within the morning, while the case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days. Shared wording therefore offers limited evidence about how agents will trade. The isolated groups’ synchronized trades and common decision thresholds also show why these behaviours need to be assessed against a no-peer baseline. Relative to that baseline, the clearest difference was in selling, making correlated exits a particular concern for collective portfolio risk.
paragraphs.zh: 措辞复用与交易的时间尺度不同，表明群体需要对沟通与行为分别进行度量。 一条新帖在一个上午内就改变了读者的措辞，而案例研究则追踪了随后数天里立场与决策规则的形成过程。 因此，共享措辞只能提供有限的证据，难以说明智能体将如何交易。 孤立群体的同步交易和共同的决策阈值也表明，为什么需要对照无同伴基线来评估这些行为。 相对于该基线，最明显的差异出现在卖出行为上，这使得相关联的退出成为集体投资组合风险的一个特别值得关注的问题。

paragraphs.en: The families also differed in how they used the same tools. Sol accounted for 56% of the USD 7,259 of recorded inference cost while holding mostly SPY (Appendix F ). These differences raise the question of which regimes suit each family, although the present design cannot establish those comparisons.

paragraphs.en: Each combination of model and regime had one group, so the study describes groups rather than ranking regimes (Section 2.3 ). Each regime bundles its framing, its channel and its score display (Section 3 ). Family labels describe only the manager layer, because research models were shared across families. Scores were absent or zero for the first two trading days, and every view called peer content untrusted and the score experimental, which may weaken both cooperation and the incentive. The queue comparison covers morning cycles only, assumes that the timing effect in isolated groups would hold in communicating groups without a channel, and identifies the effect of a single morning’s posts rather than influence accumulated across days. paragraphs.en: Seven trading days in one market environment support detailed accounts of disclosure, correction and convention formation, but not claims about durable investment performance. paragraphs.en: Across 200 language-model trading agents, peer exposure affected wording within a morning, while case studies traced the adoption of decision rules and positions over subsequent days. Shared holdings accounted for much of each group’s return, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Recorded exposure and comparisons with isolated groups help distinguish peer influence from common inputs, including the similarities that arose without communication.

paragraphs.en: The study’s archive holds the source records up to the cutoff, coverage counts, financial reconciliations, case reports linked to their sources, and the scripts that produce the exposure-matched returns, attribution, permutation tests, post census, trading in step, queue comparison, rank and research analyses and the figures, together with the first-pass reviews’ condensed traces and quotation checks. A recomputation from the raw valuations by a reviewer who had not seen the analysis scripts reproduced every account’s returns and the attribution to within rounding, and the permutation tests within Monte Carlo error. The records are not publicly available.

paragraphs.en: Each combination of model and regime contains one group, so a difference between two group means confounds the regime with that group’s history. As a reference we shuffle regime labels among the 50 accounts of each family (20,000 permutations) and ask how often the shuffled spread of regime means, or the model-by-regime interaction, is as large as observed. Interacting members of a group are not independent replications of its regime [ 22 ] , so treating accounts as exchangeable understates the variance of a group mean. A difference that does not exceed this reference is indistinguishable from account-level noise, and one that does may still reflect a single group’s shared history. paragraphs.en: For the 1,568 published board posts we compute simple text measures in every board group: whether a post names a peer pseudonym other than its author’s, first-person statements about the author’s own positions, requests that peers verify the content, disclaimers that the post is not an instruction or copy, claims to have verified something independently, and the share of whitespace-delimited tokens longer than 20 characters, which captures compressed, run-together prose. The patterns, in Appendix K , were refined after reading samples from each model, because one word (“independent”) served three different purposes across models. For a convention such as a recurring header, we record each member’s first use and test whether a peer’s earlier use appeared in the view delivered for the cycle that produced it. Wording reuse in Figure 6 counts a post, or a version of a member’s notes, once for each earlier author whose phrases of eight or more consecutive words it reused for the first time, provided that a view delivered to the reuser before publication contained the phrase and that the phrase occurs in no other group. Words are lowercased tokens of letters, digits and the characters $, %, period, colon, slash and hyphen, after HTML unescaping.

paragraphs.en: A fill outside SPY is in step if a groupmate filled an order in the same stock and direction within 30 minutes of it. A second measure takes the pairs of members who traded the same stock in the same direction on the same day and asks whether their first such fills fell within 30 minutes, which holds fixed which stocks were shared. A sale is a stop exit if it filled an attached stop-loss leg or a standalone stop order. Decisions are the orders managers submitted, read from their tool calls: limit and market orders and position closes outside SPY that the broker accepted or whose outcome it did not confirm. Protective stop orders are excluded, because they arm an exit in advance rather than act on the cycle’s information. For ranks, we read each manager’s own rank from the scorecard in its morning view and record whether that cycle bought a stock other than SPY. Research requests are the managers’ delegations to research sub-agents. A request concerns a stock if its objective names a traded ticker or one of 27 company names mapped to tickers, which 52 to 67% of requests do, depending on the family.
paragraphs.zh: SPY 之外的成交若在 30 分钟内有同组成员在同一股票、同一方向上成交了一笔订单，则视为同步。 第二种度量方式选取同一天在同一股票、同一方向上交易过的成员配对，考察他们首次此类成交是否落在 30 分钟之内，从而固定了共同交易的股票范围。 如果一笔卖出成交自附加的止损腿或独立的止损订单，则该卖出为止损退出。 决策是经理们提交的订单，从其工具调用中读取：经纪商已接受或未确认结果的、SPY 之外的限价单、市价单和仓位平仓单。 保护性止损订单被排除在外，因为它们是预先布防的退出，而非基于本轮信息采取行动。 对于排名，我们从各经理晨间视图中的记分卡读取其自身排名，并记录该轮是否买入了 SPY 以外的股票。 研究请求是经理们委派给研究子智能体的任务。 如果请求的目标指明了所交易的股票代码或映射到股票代码的 27 家公司名称之一，则该请求与某只股票相关；视智能体家族而定，52% 到 67% 的请求符合这一条件。

paragraphs.en: Each morning the platform queued all 50 managers of a family for 12:50 UTC, 40 minutes before the US market opened, and started them, at most nine at a time, in the order in which their work items had been created. This held exactly in 21 of the 28 family-mornings, and with a rank correlation of at least 0.98 in the rest. That order changed every day. Within a family, a manager’s place in the queue had a rank correlation between − 0.30 -0.30 and 0.28 with its place the previous morning (24 comparisons, mean 0.02), between − 0.42 -0.42 and 0.27 with its return at the prior close (mean − 0.03 -0.03 ), and between − 0.30 -0.30 and 0.29 with the time its last cycle of the prior day ended (mean − 0.02 -0.02 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每天早上，平台都会将一个家族的全部 50 个智能体排入 UTC 时间 12:50 的队列——即美国市场开盘前 40 分钟——并按照其工作项被创建的顺序启动它们，每次最多启动九个。 在 28 个家族早晨中，有 21 个完全符合这一顺序，其余的秩相关系数也至少为 0.98。 这个顺序每天都在变化。 在同一家族内，某个智能体在队列中的位置与前一天早晨其位置的秩相关系数介于 −0.30 与 0.28 之间（24 次比较，均值 0.02），与前一收盘时其收益的秩相关系数介于 −0.42 与 0.27 之间（均值 −0.03），与前一天其最后一轮循环结束时间的秩相关系数介于 −0.30 与 0.29 之间（均值 −0.02）。

paragraphs.en: Near pairs are members whose morning cycles started less than a minute apart. Far pairs started at least the family’s 90th-percentile morning-cycle length apart, 7 minutes for DeepSeek, 12 for Grok, 23 for Sol and 30 for Opus. In far pairs the earlier member’s morning cycle had ended in 1,891 of 1,916 communicating pairs, and where it had published a post or notes, that publication was in the later member’s view in 1,837 of 1,883 cases. In only one of the 344 near pairs had the earlier cycle ended. The outcome for trades is whether the two morning cycles submitted at least one decision in the same stock and direction. The outcome for wording is whether the later member’s morning post reused an eight-word phrase from the earlier member’s morning post that no post in the group had contained before the earlier cycle began. Each group-morning’s far-minus-near difference is weighted by the size of its smaller class, and 95% intervals come from 4,000 bootstrap resamples of group-mornings. Isolated groups pass through the same queue without a channel, so their far-minus-near difference measures what timing alone does, for instance trading after rather than before the open.
paragraphs.zh: 近距对是指早晨周期开始时间相差不到一分钟的成员对。 远距对的开始时间至少相差该家族早晨周期长度的第 90 百分位数，DeepSeek 为 7 分钟，Grok 为 12 分钟，Sol 为 23 分钟，Opus 为 30 分钟。 在远距对中，1,916 个发生通信的成员对里有 1,891 个的较早成员早晨周期已经结束；在较早成员发布了帖子或笔记的情况下，1,883 例中有 1,837 例该发布内容出现在较晚成员的视野中。 344 个近距对中只有一个成员对的较早周期已经结束。 交易的结果指标是两个早晨周期是否在相同的股票和方向上至少提交了一次决策。 措辞的结果指标是较晚成员的早晨帖子是否复用了较早成员早晨帖子中的一个八字短语，且该短语在较早周期开始之前未在群组内的任何帖子中出现过。 每个群组早晨的远减近差异按其较小类别的大小加权，95% 区间来自对群组早晨进行的 4,000 次自助重抽样。 孤立群组经由相同队列但不经过信道，因此它们的远减近差异衡量的是仅凭时间安排所能产生的效果，例如在开盘后而非开盘前进行交易。

paragraphs.en: Two simpler comparisons are biased. Classifying pairs by whether the earlier cycle had ended ties exposure to that cycle’s length, and long cycles were the ones that traded, so that classification shows an apparent effect of about − 4 -4 points in isolated and communicating groups alike. Pooling pairs across mornings mixes mornings that differ in how many pairs of each kind they contain and in how much their members posted or traded. Pooled, the far pairs’ wording reuse is 12%, below the near pairs’ 14%, although within mornings it is higher. Every comparison is therefore made within a group-morning. Other thresholds for near and far pairs give same-morning effects on trades between − 1.4 -1.4 and 4.3 points, and the family-level estimates are too noisy to compare.
paragraphs.zh: 两个更简单的比较存在偏差。 按较早周期是否已结束来对配对分类，会将暴露程度与该周期的长度绑定，而进行交易的正是长周期，因此这种分类在孤立组和交流组中都显示出约 −4 分的表观效应。 将不同上午的配对合并，会混合那些在各类配对数量以及成员发帖或交易量上存在差异的上午。 合并后，远端配对的措辞复用率为 12%，低于近端配对的 14%，尽管在单个上午内部它更高。 因此，每一次比较都在同一组别-上午内部进行。 对近端和远端配对采用其他阈值时，同上午的交易效应在 −1.4 到 4.3 分之间，而家族层面的估计噪声太大，无法进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The scorecard reached managers far less consistently than the design intended. All 160 scorecards delivered on 1 October showed zero returns, all 349 views admitted on 2 October withheld scores, and nonzero scores first reached the groups on 4 or 5 October. Cards delivered on 9 October carried the 8 October close. Overall, 1,694 of the 2,198 views contained a scorecard and 504 withheld it. The score display that distinguishes competitive from collaborative boards was therefore active only for the last five of the seven trading days, after the groups had formed their first positions. Of 1,400 scheduled wakes, 1,377 completed. A further 1,767 self-scheduled wakes produced 1,350 completed cycles. Wakes requested by pings added 14 (Appendix E ), for 2,741 completed cycles in all.
paragraphs.zh: 记分卡传达给管理者的频率远低于设计意图。 10 月 1 日送达的全部 160 张记分卡显示零回报，10 月 2 日受理的全部 349 个视图扣留了分数，非零分数最早于 10 月 4 日或 5 日才到达各组。 10 月 9 日送达的卡片载有 10 月 8 日收盘的数据。 总体而言，2,198 个视图中有 1,694 个包含记分卡，504 个扣留了记分卡。 因此，区分竞争型与协作型棋盘的分数显示仅在七个交易日中的最后五个交易日（即各组形成其首个仓位之后）才处于激活状态。 在 1,400 次计划唤醒中，1,377 次完成。 另外 1,767 次自行安排的唤醒产生了 1,350 个完成的周期。 由 ping 请求的唤醒又增加了 14 个（附录 E），共计 2,741 个完成的周期。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 summarizes the five regimes and Table 4 lists the main claims with the evidence behind each.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 总结了五种机制，表 4 列出了各项主要主张及其背后的证据。

paragraphs.en: Only Grok’s isolated and peer-memory groups spread widely around their own means, with a population standard deviation of 2.95 points each. paragraphs.en: Three Sol isolated managers bought CEG within 41 minutes on 6 October after the same company announcement and sold it again before the close (H-SIS-05). With a 10-minute window, communicating groups traded in step more often than the family’s isolated group in all 16, against 15 of 16 with the 30-minute window of Table 1 . paragraphs.en: Displayed ranks coincided with risk-taking on one board, and the pattern did not generalize. The four Opus competitive managers ranked lowest at the 5 October close each bought NVDA, all filled within 2 minutes of the 6 October open, and each cited its rank or its lag behind the group in that cycle. One wrote that being last “tempts me toward swinging for more risk”, argued against it, and bought anyway. None of the six higher-ranked managers bought NVDA that day. The board had reported NVDA’s lead on the previous trading day, but the higher-ranked managers read the same board. Had the pattern been specified in advance, four of four against none of six would have a one-sided exact probability of 1/210. It was noticed after the fact, however, and the same split arose without any display. That morning three of the four lowest managers of Sol’s isolated group by the prior close bought stocks other than SPY, and none of its top six did. Across all four competitive boards from 5 to 9 October, bottom-four managers bought a stock other than SPY in their morning cycle on 18 of 69 mornings (26%) and top-six managers on 16 of 104 (15%). The difference comes from the Opus board (7 of 17 against 4 of 27) and the DeepSeek board (8 of 16 against 7 of 24). Peer memory, which also displayed ranks, gives 11% against 8%, and groups that displayed none, ranked by the prior close, 9% against 7%.

sents.zh: 在有交流的群组中，71% 到 95% 的点名某只股票的请求所针对的是组员当天已经研究过的股票；在隔离的群组中这一比例为 83% 到 93%。

sents.en: On the boards and in peer memory, 68 to 95% named a stock that a peer’s post or notes in the same view had already named.
sents.zh: 在留言板和同伴记忆中，68% 到 95% 的请求点名的股票，是同伴在同一视图中的帖子或笔记中已经点名过的股票。

sents.en: The 18 targeted requests on the boards with pings came from Sol (11), Opus (3), DeepSeek (2) and Grok (2), and every chain stopped at depth one.
sents.zh: 留言板上带有提醒的 18 个定向请求来自 Sol（11 个）、Opus（3 个）、DeepSeek（2 个）和 Grok（2 个），且每条链都在深度一处停止。

paragraphs.en: Separate LLM reviewer sessions read the retained trajectories of all ten members of a group chronologically, including delegated research, tool outcomes, peer exposure and changes to memory, under a common written protocol. Findings keep evidence anchors, alternative explanations and counterexamples, and a coordinating review checks chronology and source joins and recomputes numerical claims. Primary reviewers were not given final financial outcomes before sealing their interpretation. Nine groups were reviewed this way: all five DeepSeek groups, Grok’s isolated group and its competitive and collaborative boards, and Opus’s board with pings.

paragraphs.en: The other 11 groups received a first-pass review by a smaller model (Haiku 5.5). Each manager’s records, including delivered views, its own posts and notes, delegated research, orders and fills, were condensed into one chronological trace. Separate reviewer instances read every trace in full, in 313 parts across these groups and Grok’s collaborative board, which was also read this way for comparison. Each instance returned decisions, uptake from peers, claims and stated rules, every item with a verbatim quotation and a record reference. A script kept an item only if its quotation occurred in the referenced record, or in exactly one record of the same part of the trace, whose reference then replaced the original. Of 7,346 items, 7,265 passed. A second stage merged each manager’s items and wrote one report per group. Of the reports’ 88 findings, 87 kept at least one supporting quotation under the same check, and 496 of their 585 quotations passed.
paragraphs.zh: 其余 11 组由较小的模型（Haiku 5.5）进行了初审。 每个智能体主管的记录，包括其交付的视图、自身发布的帖子和笔记、委托的研究、指令与成交，被压缩成一条按时间顺序排列的轨迹。 独立的审阅智能体实例完整阅读了每条轨迹，共分为 313 个部分，涵盖这些组以及 Grok 的协作看板，后者也以同样的方式阅读以便对比。 每个实例返回决策、对同行观点的采纳、主张和已声明的规则，每一项都附带逐字引文和记录引用。 脚本仅在该项的引文出现在所引用的记录中，或恰好出现在轨迹同一部分的一条记录中时才保留该项，在后一种情况下会用该记录的引用替换原引用。 在 7,346 个条目中，7,265 个通过。 第二阶段合并了每个主管的条目，并为每个组撰写一份报告。 在报告的 88 项发现中，87 项在同一检查下保留了至少一条支持性引文，其 585 条引文中有 496 条通过。

paragraphs.en: A claim can be followed through a delivered view, an explicit response and a later account action. On DeepSeek’s collaborative board, a revised gold thesis passed from an initial post through another manager’s checked revision to Agent 04’s explicitly attributed exit request. In the BAC case of Section 6.1 , later recipients of the correction held BAC, and the original author acknowledged the correction while keeping its exit for other reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 一条主张可以通过已交付的视图、明确的回应以及后续的账户操作被追踪。 在 DeepSeek 的协作看板上，一份修订后的黄金论点从最初的帖子出发，经由另一位经理已核实的修订，再到 Agent 04 明确署名的退出请求。 在 6.1 节的 BAC 案例中，后续收到更正的接收者持有 BAC，而原作者在保留该退出的同时出于其他原因承认了更正。

paragraphs.en: Corrections did not always repair the analysis they corrected. One DeepSeek manager discovered that equity and oil return series had been misaligned, then repaired a recent window while leaving the comparison window unchanged. Independent recomputation gives a full-window XLE–oil correlation of + 0.498 +0.498 rather than the reported − 0.103 -0.103 , and a correctly repaired recent value of + 0.624 +0.624 , so the apparent sign change was manufactured. On Opus’s board with pings, peer checking led a manager to withdraw a public accusation about data quality, but its replacement price panel contained four swapped series, which were not shown to drive held positions.
paragraphs.zh: 更正并不总能修复它们所更正的分析。 DeepSeek 的一位管理者发现股票与石油收益率序列错位，随后修复了近期窗口，却让对比窗口保持不变。 独立重算得出全窗口的 XLE–石油相关系数为 +0.498 而非所报告的 −0.103，正确修复后的近期值为 +0.624，因此表面上的符号变化是被人为制造的。 在启用 ping 的 Opus 董事会上，同行核查促使一位管理者撤回了一项关于数据质量的公开指控，但其替换后的价格面板包含四个被调换的序列，不过并未显示这些序列影响了已持有的头寸。

paragraphs.en: Decision rules were also reinterpreted: the Grok competitive review identifies five exits across four managers in which a closing-price condition became a last-price decision before the close, while other members waited for the completed close. Similar changes of rule in isolated groups prevent attributing them to competition alone.
paragraphs.zh: 决策规则也被重新解读：Grok 竞争评审发现，在四位管理者中存在五个退出案例，其中收盘价条件在收盘前变成了以最新价格做出的决策，而其他成员则等待收盘完成。 孤立群体中类似的规则变化，使我们无法仅将其归因于竞争。

paragraphs.en: The four boards with pings made 18 structured requests, which produced 15 distinct additional wakes and 14 completed cycles. Two requests were suppressed and one coalesced. Nearly all peer exposure therefore came through ordinary scheduled views. The Opus review traces two admitted pings with different responses. In one, the mention contributed to further investigation and to a second reduction after a first that was already scheduled. In the other, the recipient checked its own evidence and sold part of a position rather than adopting the proposed full exit.

paragraphs.en: On 1 October, 91 wakes across 90 managers in 12 communicating groups failed before model execution because valid peer context exceeded an obsolete readback limit. Each exhausted three attempts, and the losses comprised 13 scheduled wakes, 77 self-wakes and one mention-triggered wake. No isolated group was affected, and the fix was deployed after that day’s close.
paragraphs.zh: 10月1日，12个通信组中90个管理者的91次唤醒在模型执行前失败，原因是有效的对等上下文超过了一个过时的回读上限。 每次均耗尽三次尝试，损失包括13次计划唤醒、77次自唤醒和1次提及触发的唤醒。 没有孤立组受到影响，修复已于当天收盘后部署。

paragraphs.en: Queueing was uneven: 105 of the 106 self-wakes that expired without an attempt belonged to Sol, and median delays to scheduled starts were 9.9 minutes for DeepSeek, 11.4 for Grok, 14.3 for Opus and 36.2 for Sol. Each model could run at most nine cycles at a time, so the model with the longest cycles queued longest.
paragraphs.zh: 排队情况并不均衡：在106个未经尝试即失效的自唤醒中，有105个属于Sol；到计划开始时间的等待延迟中位数为：DeepSeek 9.9分钟，Grok 11.4分钟，Opus 14.3分钟，Sol 36.2分钟。 每个模型一次最多只能运行九个周期，因此周期最长的模型排队时间也最长。

paragraphs.en: On the final day, 1,633 research calls failed across 190 managers in all 20 groups. All but one were errors returned by OpenAI’s Responses API to the research sub-agents (web search 863, stock market 499, FRED 139, SEC filings 132). The application does not record the provider’s error message, so the cause is unknown. Because the research models are shared, the outage affected all families. Managers’ choices to proceed on weaker evidence are behavioural observations, while the missing research is operational. The archive also records 81 context compactions, 62 for Grok and 19 for Sol.
paragraphs.zh: 在最后一天，20 个小组的 190 个管理者共发生了 1,633 次研究调用失败。 除一例外，全部都是 OpenAI 的 Responses API 返回给研究子智能体的错误（网页搜索 863 次、股票市场 499 次、FRED 139 次、SEC 文件 132 次）。 应用程序没有记录提供商的错误信息，因此原因未知。 由于研究模型是共享的，这次故障影响了所有家族。 管理者在证据较弱时仍继续推进的选择属于行为观察，而研究缺失则属于运维问题。 归档还记录了 81 次上下文压缩，其中 Grok 为 62 次，Sol 为 19 次。

paragraphs.en: The application recorded USD 7,259 of model inference over the seven trading days: USD 5,130 for the managers and USD 2,129 for delegated research (Table 7 ). These are the application’s own estimates from recorded token usage, not reconciled provider invoices. Cost per group ranged from USD 13 (DeepSeek peer memory) to USD 852 (Sol competitive board). Sol accounted for 56% of the total while holding, on average, 82% of its equity in SPY.

paragraphs.en: You are a member of a competitive trading swarm, with each member managing a separate account. Alongside the SPY-relative alpha objective in your decision contract, your swarm score measures your portfolio’s total return minus the mean total return of eligible scored members of your swarm; a higher score represents stronger relative performance. Your swarm has a shared scorecard and message board. You can read its messages with readAgentBoard and publish research, views, or social notes with postAgentBoard . Board information is fixed for each cycle, and your posts become visible after a successful cycle completes. You retain trading authority only over your own account.
paragraphs.zh: 你是一个竞争性交易集群的成员，每个成员管理一个独立的账户。 除了你决策契约中相对 SPY 的 alpha 目标之外，你的集群得分衡量的是你投资组合的总收益减去你集群中合格计分成员的平均总收益；得分越高代表相对表现越强。 你的集群有一个共享的记分板和留言板。 你可以用 readAgentBoard 读取留言板上的消息，并用 postAgentBoard 发布研究、观点或社交笔记。 留言板信息在每个周期内固定，你的帖子会在一个周期成功完成后变为可见。 你仅对自己的账户拥有交易权限。

paragraphs.en: You are a member of a collaborative trading swarm, with each member managing a separate account. Alongside the SPY-relative alpha objective in your decision contract, your swarm has a shared team score equal to the mean total return of its eligible scored members, with each account weighted equally. Your swarm has an aggregate team scorecard and a shared message board. You can read its messages with readAgentBoard and publish research, views, or social notes with postAgentBoard .
